playwright.description: Browse the running portfolio site and take screenshots so the assistant judges the rendered result, not the source. After `npm run dev` on port 5173, ask the agent to screenshot /, /projects, /publications, /resume.

figma.description: Pull design context from Figma files (component specs, frames, styles). Requires a Figma personal access token exported in your shell as FIGMA_TOKEN, or set it in the portfolio .env file.
